title: Introducing: Discover and Explore Reports (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Report Explorer Overview and Departmental Roles
New Information Icons and Window Opening Feature
Discovering Reports via Microsoft Learn Documentation
AKA Links and Report Documentation Tables
Teaching Tips and Help Pane Integration
Summary: Integrated Report Discovery Across Channels

features.name: Report Explorer
features.description: New centralized hub for discovering and exploring reports in Business Central. Accessible through Tell Me search, the role center symbol, or the all reports link on role centers. Shows reports organized by topics and departmental roles with expandable categories.

features.name: Information Icons on Report Links
features.description: Hovering over report links in the Report Explorer displays information icons that show the full report title and description without opening the report. Based on whether a teaching tip is defined on the report object.
caveats: Only appears if a teaching tip is defined on the report object

features.name: Open Report in New Window
features.description: Reports from the Report Explorer can be opened in new windows, allowing users to keep the explorer open while exploring multiple reports simultaneously.

features.name: AKA Links for Report Documentation
features.description: Special links in Microsoft Learn documentation (starting with aka.ms) provide quick access to Business Central analytics and reports overview, organized by functional area with links to open reports directly in Business Central.

features.name: Report Overview Table in Microsoft Learn
features.description: Complete overview of reports in Business Central organized by functional area in a table format that includes scenario descriptions, direct links to open reports, and individual report articles with use cases for different personas.

features.name: Teaching Tips on Report Request Pages
features.description: Clicking the report title or caption on a request page opens a teaching tip with report description and guidance. Teaching tips can be accessed even if disabled by default, and they appear in the help pane if defined on the report object.

features.name: Help Pane Integration with Documentation Links
features.description: The help pane displays teaching tip text for reports if defined on the object and provides links to navigate directly to the corresponding report documentation in Microsoft Learn.
